purpose: Source inventory for the flood evidence-fusion gate. These records document candidates and limits; they are not themselves observations and do not authorize numerical predictions.

ksdma_historical_raster.title: KSDMA historical flood-return raster
ksdma_historical_raster.use: Context only; do not sample or threshold pixels until exact value semantics and reuse terms are confirmed.

ksdma_ernakulam_pdf.title: KSDMA Ernakulam district flood-hazard maps
ksdma_ernakulam_pdf.use: District-level contextual review only; not ward-level or facility-level exposure.

cwc_rainfall_observations.title: CWC hourly rainfall observations in the project repository
cwc_rainfall_observations.use: Only after station-time conflicts, time zone, observation interval, and missingness are handled.

cwc_river_observations.title: CWC river-level observations in the project repository
cwc_river_observations.use: Source-reported reading only until gauge datum, station identity, and warning thresholds are confirmed.

eidc_rainfall_ddf.title: Kerala gridded rainfall depth-duration-frequency estimates (1979–2020)
eidc_rainfall_ddf.use: Historical modelled rainfall-frequency context; not live forecast rainfall.

eidc_flood_frequency.title: Kerala gridded flood-frequency estimates
eidc_flood_frequency.use: River-network peak-flow frequency context; not local inundation depth or flood probability.

imd_forecast.title: India Meteorological Department official forecasts and warnings
imd_forecast.use: Operational context only after source, issue time, valid time, spatial coverage, and product are captured.

terrain_drainage.title: Terrain, drainage, and local infrastructure evidence
terrain_drainage.use: Required for local waterlogging mechanisms; source, resolution, and reuse must be checked before ingestion.
